QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the temperature of 0.05 M sucrose solution in Kelvin if the osmotic pressure of the solution is 1.5 atm. ($R = 0.0821 \, \text{dm}^3 \, \text{atm} \, \text{K}^{-1} \, \text{mol}^{-1}$)

Solution.S:
Osmotic pressure is given by $\Pi = CRT$.

Given: $\Pi = 1.5$ atm, $C = 0.05$ mol L⁻¹, $R = 0.0821$ dm³ atm K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.

$$T = \frac{\Pi}{CR} = \frac{1.5}{0.05 \times 0.0821}$$

$$= \frac{1.5}{0.004105} \approx 365.4 \text{ K}$$

Thus, the correct option is D: 365.4 K.
